alias_review_rule: Flag abs(unwrapped chain mean t0)>period/2 for mechanism review only; this is not a replacement gate, no draw is wrapped/removed, and false positives are possible for unusual ephemeris geometry.
claim_limit: Small prospective numerical study, not precise calibration or universal alias prevention. All new realizations and rejected attempts remain. Three local benchmark repetitions share one observational dataset and the SAME historical external posterior; they are not three independent external validations. Numerical agreement is not astrophysical adequacy.
exclusion: Engineering pilots and historical campaigns are not new final replicates. No other exclusions.
execution_note: Prepared but not automatically launched by the agent. Commit tested sources and freeze/commit ledger before user-authorized execution. Soft budget pauses between jobs; extending the operational budget does not change scientific configuration.
failure_policy: Zero automatic retries. Technical failure remains technical; completed numerical/scientific rejection remains rejected. Missing metrics are unavailable, never zero or measured noncoverage.

gates.inherited_ppc: Observed fraction in posterior predictive 94% intervals within [.80,.99], standardized residual SD within [.5,2]; broad screening not an exact calibration test
gates.promotion: Separate provenance, sampler, PPC and final scientific interpretability. Aggregate negative findings can use rejected runs with explicit classification; positive individual claims require all relevant gates.
gates.provenance: Exact input SHA256 and content-derived synthetic dataset ID, committed protocol and complete predeclared registry; no existing-run overwrite
gates.sampler: All scalar sampled/derived summary Rhat<=1.01; bulk/tail ESS>=400; zero divergences; BFMI>=.30. Record tree-depth saturation separately; no numerical repair by deleting draws.
gates.scale: Inherited M5 jitter/median_error<=20 and <=5% posterior r outside inherited review interval [.00349,.24751]. This interval is a heuristic scientific review range, not LogNormal support.
gates.temporal_ppc: No within-segment cadence-contiguous residual correlation at lags1-5 beyond normal Bonferroni reference z_(1-.01/10)/sqrt(Npairs). Approximate fitted-residual screen; false positives/negatives measured, not assumed controlled exactly.

hypothesis: z~Normal(0,1), t0=.025*z preserves the physical prior while default coordinate-space jitter starts nearer its physical scale; benefit is empirical, not guaranteed.
hypothesis_rejection_conditions: standardization does not improve or worsens numerical diagnostics in tested controls
alias trapping persists under standardized coordinates
higher accuracy retains divergent/nonconverged ablation baselines
validly matched sampler-passing local fits materially disagree with the external posterior
inclusion: All 24 declared jobs, all attempts, all seeds, all failed or rejected outcomes. No posterior-based selection or exclusion.

inference.known_design_assumptions: Period, time convention, exposure, segment and measurement errors known. Fixed truth r,b,a,t0,jitter,q1,q2 are not used to set priors or initialize chains.

inference_assumptions.derived: depth=r^2 geometric; T14=P/pi asin(sqrt(((1+r)^2-b^2)/(a^2-b^2))) in days
inference_assumptions.jitter: HalfNormal(max(5 median(measured_sigma), .0005)) normalized flux; data-scale rule declared, not truth-informed
inference_assumptions.likelihood: Independent Gaussian(mu_transit + baseline, sqrt(measured_sigma_i^2 + extra_sigma^2)); no temporal covariance
inference_assumptions.orbit: circular, period fixed; a/Rs Uniform(2,50), b Uniform(0,1), so grazing b>1 is outside supported prior domain
inference_assumptions.radius: LogNormal(log(.04), .9), same population-scale reference for ALL scenarios, not truth-matched
inference_assumptions.sampler: PyMC NUTS, jitter+adapt_diag, one attempt per identity, no automatic retries or alternative seeds
inference_assumptions.t0: Normal(0,.025) days, same across all scenarios

invalidation_conditions: input or frozen config identity changes
outputs: all registered attempt configs, truth (synthetic only), traces including warmup, diagnostics, PPC and completion checksums
pilot_policy: All t0_coordinate_pilot_v1/debug outcomes excluded from final counts; no seed selected by pilot quality.
primary_metrics: t0 chain means relative to physical period without wrapping
question: Does an equivalent standardized t0 coordinate reduce alias initialization/trapping without changing physical posterior targets?
secondary_metrics: fixed-truth bias and ETI50/80/94 coverage (descriptive, n=3)
seed_policy: Existing campaign_plan.seed with this NEW campaign namespace. Within synthetic pairs only generation seed is shared via pair_id; independent inference/predictive/resampling streams are fixed in the committed ledger. No reseeding after rejection.
selection_timing: Post-historical-results hypothesis, prospectively fixed NEW datasets and inference seeds. Historical failures motivate the study but are not its independent final validation.
statistical_interpretation: Paired descriptive numerical robustness, not a powered rate-comparison test. At n=3 rate precision is poor; report every pair and missing pair. ETI is not HDI, fixed-truth coverage is not SBC, and r/depth=r^2 are not independent confirmations.
